outcome: Persistent cesarean scar pregnancy (PCSP) after dilation and curettage (D&C)
cohort: 45 cases of PCSP patients after D&C and 180 controls who had CSP but no residual CSP tissue after D&C
finding: The study identified three risk factors for PCSP after D&C: maximum diameter of CSP mass ≥4.5 cm, myometrial thickness at the implantation site <2 mm, and a ≤66.42% decrease rate in β-hCG levels on the first day after D&C.
